sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
The core gameplay mechanics of DiDash are simple yet engaging. Players control a small character that must navigate 
         through a series of obstacles, including walls, traps, and other hazards. The game features a variety of obstacles, 
         including moving walls, spinning traps, and pitfalls. Players must use their quick reflexes and sharp timing to avoid 
         these obstacles and progress through the levels.

         One of the key features of DiDash is its use of gravity. Players must navigate their character through levels that 
         feature different gravitational forces, making it challenging to control their character's movement. This adds an 
         extra layer of complexity to the game, requiring players to think strategically and plan their movements carefully.

         The game also features a variety of power-ups and bonuses, including speed boosts, shields, and score multipliers. 
         These items can be collected throughout the levels, giving players an advantage in their quest to progress through the 
         game.
